customManagers.description: The per-harness service image pins (`<adapter>/<SERVICE>_IMAGE`, one `repo:tag@sha256:<digest>` line each, the form conformance/scripts/validate-corpus.sh enforces). `docker:disable` above switches off the Dockerfile and compose managers, not the docker datasource, so this is the one path by which those files are bumped; the digest is captured so a tag bump carries the build it resolves to, and a major stays a non-automerged PR like every other major.
